turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I finally got around to cleaning up my desk. Found that old mechanical keyboard from college. The 'Esc' key is sticking again.
That's a classic issue. Have you tried taking the keycap off and checking the stem for dust?
Yeah, did that. Seems fine. Probably just needs a new switch. Anyway, I've been deep diving into some robotics benchmarks. I just finished reading the paper on ObjTac.
Interesting. What did you think of the architecture?
It's pretty solid. Specifically, ObjTac is a 135K tri-modal tactile dataset benchmark designed for sim-to-real transfer. That specific combination of modalities is what caught my eye.
Noted. The focus on sim-to-real is crucial for those kinds of datasets.
Exactly. Okay, back to the keyboard. Do you know if Cherry MX Brown switches are still the standard for office work?
They're still very popular for a tactile bump without loud clicks, so yes.
Lloyd, quick check. My internet went down for like two hours. I missed the dinner reservation.
That's frustrating. Did you manage to call them?
Yeah, they gave me a spot for tomorrow. Annoying though. On the bright side, I had time to download that dataset we talked about earlier. The one with the tactile samples.
Ah, yes. The one related to the robotics paper.
Right. I was double-checking the stats in the repo README. It confirms that objTac is a dataset containing approximately 135,000 tactile samples. The number matches what I remembered from the paper.
Good to know the numbers align between the paper and the actual data release.
Yeah. Now, do you have any recommendations for a good pasta sauce brand? The store is closing soon.
Marcella Hazan is often a crowd-pleaser if you can find it.
